official_measurement_examples.name: National dataset coverage limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Data reported 21 design-code records from 10 providers; collector last ran 16 July 2026 and the dataset states the current records were created by MHCLG pending authoritative-source replacement.

official_measurement_examples.name: Area dataset limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: The design-code-area dataset reported 11 areas from 6 providers with collector activity in July 2026; absence from this national dataset is not proof that a local authority has no design code.

official_measurement_examples.name: Status separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Planning Data distinguishes proposed, draft, adopted, withdrawn and informal design-code statuses; these statuses must not be merged as equivalent policy weight.

official_measurement_examples.name: NMDC policy status
official_measurement_examples.fact: The National Model Design Code is detailed guidance and a toolkit; it is not itself a site-specific adopted local design code or planning permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Decision weight context
official_measurement_examples.fact: NPPF says design guides and codes can carry decision-making weight when produced through appropriate plan or supplementary-document routes; a draft or developer-prepared code does not automatically have adopted-policy status.

official_measurement_examples.name: 2026 consultation guard
official_measurement_examples.fact: The Design and Placemaking PPG published for consultation in January 2026 is consultation material and must not be treated as final operative guidance unless and until adopted.

official_measurement_examples.name: BHL 2026 distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Building for a Healthy Life 2026 is a flexible design evaluation tool that can support policy and codes; it is not a statutory design-code designation or consent.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Design-code coverage does not establish ownership, planning permission, exact buildable area or final development yield without proposal-specific policy and design assessment.

core_rules: national design-code dataset is not exhaustive local coverage
MHCLG-created derivative data is not authoritative local adoption evidence
proposed draft adopted withdrawn informal statuses remain distinct
National Model Design Code is guidance not site-specific permission
design code does not itself establish land ownership
draft design code is not adopted policy
developer-prepared code is not automatically adopted policy
local code applicability requires geographic and temporal match
consultation draft is not final operative guidance
Building for a Healthy Life is an evaluation tool not consent
design-code area geometry is not cadastral ownership geometry
absence from national dataset is not proof of no local code
code compliance does not replace other planning constraints
design code does not calculate development yield
no parcel design clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Official Planning Data and GOV.UK sources checked 2026-07-26. July 2026 collector states and the 2026 Design/Placemaking consultation and Building for a Healthy Life edition were retained with adoption/status/coverage limitations; no parcel promotion.
